stances_toward.note: The three juntas (Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger) expelled French forces and moved toward Russia; the Africa Corps replaced France in Mali. In November 2025 France told its nationals to leave Mali as the JNIM blockade tightened, and in April-May 2026 the JNIM-FLA offensive threatened the junta in Bamako. Rival, not adversary: France has no aim to bring the juntas down. Bond - grievance (colonial and the 2013-2022 Barkhane period).
